hooks.command: node -e "console.log('PROJECT RULES: read CLAUDE.md, PLAN.md and the files in project-os before doing anything in this session. Conversations.md governs every reply you write. node -e "console.log('STANDING RULES for this reply and this task: 1) Reply exactly as project-os/Conversations.md prescribes: English, terse, ---- dividers with H1 headings, one sentence per line, no long dashes. 2) One action at a time: no subagents, no parallel tool calls. 3) Run the PLAN.md steps in order without stopping for approval; tick each checkbox in the same change. Stop only for a real problem, a step that is his, or anything that reaches the public such as deploying. 4) At pickup say the risk level, and which model and effort this task deserves: Opus medium for routine work, Fable high for the API client, the composer and autosave, the image flows, stubborn bugs and reviews. 5) Change only what was asked, smallest safe change. 6) Never write outside this project folder; scratch goes in .tmp/. 7) After any completed change add its History row. 8) Never say a check passed unless it actually ran. 9) Rotem starts the dev server and pushes to GitHub, never you. 10) Dark mode only, and a typed note is never lost or overwritten by an older save.')"
